description.en: *This product is scheduled to be sold at THE GUNDAM BASE stores, various events, and overseas. *Sales methods are subject to change without notice. MG 1/100 Wing Gundam Zero EW is now available in CROSS CONTRAST COLORS! A complete change from the original image of the aircraft, the dark-toned clear and solid color design gives off a sense of sinisterness, while the glossy red metallic color and mirror-like silver decals that seem to erode the asymmetrical design of the aircraft accentuate its brilliance, giving it a luxurious finish. • Pay attention to the coloring effect that combines various materials such as solid, clear, and metallic. • Includes a glittering mirror water transfer decal. • Comes with a clear purple action base perfect for posing.
